title: Count Athena's passing same-tree checks as run commands under D43
summary: `judge` in verify.rs treats a behavior criterion's cited command as seen when the verifier ran it, or when Athena ran and recorded it on this candidate tree and it passed. A failed recorded check, or one recorded for another tree, still fails D43. The audience is the verifier and the maintainers who read D43. Both cases are tested and D43's docs are updated.

defaults_applied.how: New tests cover the pass case, the failed-record case and the other-tree case, and cargo test and clippy must stay clean.
The criteria check that `judge` marks the criterion met or unmet, by running named cargo test filters. They do not check that the field exists.
The fix is in `judge`'s notion of 'ran', not in the verifier prompt or the one job's verdict.
Behavior criteria name cargo test, clippy and fmt --check as the commands to run.
The D43 amendment and the doc comments are written for an outside reader and cite the commit and job.
The rule is enforced in `judge` code with tests, not left as prose.
One focused change: the judge rule, its one caller, tests and docs.
The decision entry cites job 20261024-033933-ta60 and commit 88562f1 as its source.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Recorded checks are the `CheckRun`s in `VerdictInputs.checks`. Their command is the check's `command` joined with spaces, the same text the verifier brief shows under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'. A cited command is matched through the D63 simple-command normalisation, so `cargo test` matches a recorded `cargo test` and does not match `cargo test --all`.

'Same tree' needs an input `judge` does not have today, because `CheckRun` has no tree field. `VerdictInputs` gains a field saying the recorded checks were run on the candidate tree being judged (for example the checks' tree fingerprint and the candidate's). `run.rs` fills it in. A mismatch or an absent value means recorded checks count for nothing.

A recorded check counts only if `passed` is true and it really ran. Nested-run placeholders whose note says 'not run', and the synthetic 'producer-report-gaps' entry, never count. A check marked pre-existing failing has `passed` false and does not count either.

The change amends D43 in docs/decisions.md with a new decision entry, the way D62 and D63 do. It adds a link entry in docs/decision-links.toml with the right line number, and it updates the module doc of verify.rs.
The verifier prompt (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md) already tells verifiers to cite the record, so it needs no change.

acceptance_criteria.text: A unit test shows a behavior criterion citing `cargo test` is met with `commands_verified` true and no D43 finding when the verifier ran nothing, but a passing `cargo test` check is recorded for the same candidate tree. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet, with the D43 'cited but not seen running' finding, when the recorded `cargo test` check failed. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
A unit test shows the criterion is still unmet when the passing recorded check is for a different tree than the candidate. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.

Existing D43/D63 tests still pass: a command the verifier never ran and that was not recorded is unseen, and a behavior criterion with no commands is still unmet. Run `cargo test -p athena-core verify`.
`cargo test` passes for the workspace, `cargo clippy` is clean, and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

The module doc of crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs and the `commands_run` and new input field docs state the rule: a cited command is seen if the verifier ran it, or if Athena ran and recorded it on the same candidate tree and it passed. They also state that failed or other-tree records do not count.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision that amends D43 with the rule, alternatives, tradeoff, and provenance citing job 20261024-033933-ta60 and commit 88562f1. docs/decision-links.toml links it to D43 as 'amended' and the validated line numbers are correct. The D43 section or its amendment note points to the new decision.
crates/athena-core/src/run.rs passes the recorded checks and the same-tree indication into `judge` so the live pipeline gets the new behavior. Nested-run 'not run' placeholders are excluded.

out_of_scope: Re-judging or re-running job 20261024-033933-ta60, or changing the records-branch writer in athena-git.
Changing the verifier prompt or which commands the verifier may run.
Loosening D43 for commands the producer ran, or for commands recorded only in CI for other commits.
Changing check routing, the CI result reuse logic, or how checks are executed.
departures: Slightly higher cost and time than the reference: the change touches judge, its caller in run.rs, a new decision entry and a line-numbered decision-links file, which needs a validated line number.
